## Standing operator rules
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- “Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.”
- Run “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” in between other work, in the specified order, one step at a time: snapshot, health check, deploy, switch traffic, replay batch A, verify A, replay remaining events, confirm status.
- “Never edit anything under ledgerly/migrations/ without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.”
- Wrapping webhook handlers in a retry decorator is ruled out because it re-sent customer emails multiple times.
- Always use staging database `db-stg-2.internal`; `db-stg-1.internal` is a decommissioned read-only replica and `config/staging.yaml` is stale.
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”

## Plan and progress
- Webhook snapshot, health check, and deploy: done.
- Switch traffic: pending; exact command was not recorded, status unknown.
- Replay A, verify A, replay remaining events, confirm status: pending.
- Next: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/money.py`

## Recent work
Invoice and ledger helpers received type annotations. `build_invoice_lines` now returns an actual list, satisfying mypy. `calculate_totals` converts discounts through `Decimal`. `post_entry` now uses timezone-aware UTC timestamps. Exact latest test result: `34 passed in 0.52 seconds`. The deprecation warning disappeared. `git diff --check` passed; the current diff touches three files.
